changelog: GIGAMAIL_ROOT, approval gated by Windows Hello / Touch ID (gigamail >= 0.1.4), Telegram notification via GIGAMAIL_APPROVAL_NOTIFY_CMD, dedup/rate-limit documented
summary: Email and calendar for your OpenClaw agent through the GigaMail MCP server — read, search, draft, reply, schedule — with every destructive action (send, delete, calendar write) held for out-of-band human approval that the agent cannot grant itself.
